data.long_meaning: Sheetala refers to coolness and Prasad means grace or divine gift. This name signifies the blessings and grace of God. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sheetalaprasad usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, divine gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sheetalaprasad is rooted in Hindu culture and derives from reverence for the Goddess Sheetala, who is believed to provide relief from heat and diseases associated with it, like fever, smallpox, or cholera. The name Sheetala symbolizes the soothing and calming aspect of nature, and Prasad adds the idea of receiving a divine blessing.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, Sheetalaprasad embodies the idea of experiencing and receiving divine grace. Prasad, meaning divine grace or gift, reinforces the idea of being blessed with spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name serves as a daily reminder to seek and cherish the blessings of the Divine Mother and remind us to carry leniency, compassion, and forgiveness within ourselves to uplift ourselves and the ones around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sheetalaprasad: The name Sheetal signifies coolness and calmness, while Prasad represents the divine grace and blessings bestowed upon an individual. Together, the name symbolizes the attainment of inner peace and divine blessings, allowing one to overcome life's challenges with grace and composure.

historical_references.context: Jain Tirthankaras are considered the spiritual teachers and saviors in Jainism. Sheetalaprasad is one among the 24 Tirthankaras in the current cycle of time.
